parts.title: WRITING TASK 1
parts.passage:
WRITING TASK 1

You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The diagram below shows how one type of desert, known as a rain-shadow desert, is formed.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

The formation of rain-shadow deserts

1. Sea / Winds approach coast

2. Moist air rises and cools (Windward side)

3. Clouds form / Rain falls

4. Dry air continues over mountain

5. Winds pushed / Leeward side

6. Dry winds reach inland areas (Inland) / Rain-shadow desert

questions.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
questions.content: Write at least 150 words for Writing Task 1.

parts.title: WRITING TASK 2
parts.passage:
WRITING TASK 2

You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

All university undergraduate courses should include a period of time spent studying abroad or doing a work placement.

Do you think the advantages of this would outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questions.instruction: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
questions.content: Write at least 250 words for Writing Task 2.
